description: This PHP source file defines a class ConfigFileAPI within the OrangeHRM installer module. It extends another API class and overrides methods to handle configuration file updates during installation, including database info storage and error handling related to encryption keys.

classes.name: ConfigFileAPI
classes.description: A class handling API requests for configuration files during installation, with custom logic for saving database credentials, handling encryption keys, and interacting with the installation state.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to process POST requests, including database info encryption handling and storing credentials.

methods.name: getRegistrationType
methods.description: Returns the registration type constant indicating installer start.
